item.title: $180k worth of Pokémon cards stolen during smash-and-grab in Anaheim
item.description: Brazen thieves tunneled their way into a collectibles store in Anaheim, stealing approximately $180,000 worth of Pokémon cards. The entire incident was caught on surveillance video. According to Anaheim police, four suspects broke into Do-We Collectibles on Harbor Blvd. Wednesday, Feb. 18 around 3 a.m. Video shows the suspects breaking the glass on a front door of an insurance office next door. item.title: Crash near Long Beach airport kills at least 4 people
item.description: At least four people are dead after a car crashed into a concrete divider near the Long Beach Airport. The collision shut down Lakewood Boulevard south of Spring Street for several hours Saturday, Feb. 21. Investigators say the sedan crashed into the concrete divider of a tunnel that runs under the Long Beach Airport just after 1 a.m. The charred car was seen being taken from the scene by a tow truck. item.title: TSA PreCheck still operational after previous announcement of suspension during shutdown

item.title: Lakewood gas station video shows armed man attempting to carjack vehicle with baby inside
item.description: A suspect has been arrested after a disturbing incident caught on camera at a Lakewood gas station.The video shows the moments when a shirtless man attempted to carjack a woman’s vehicle while her baby was inside.
